description_en: Queries the resources you share with other accounts or the resources other accounts share with you
description_zh: 查询共享的资源列表或者其他账号共享的资源列表
name: ListSharedResources

parameters.help_en:
The owner of the resource share. Valid values:

Self: Queries the resources that you shared with other accounts from your resource shares.

OtherAccounts: Queries the resources that were shared with you by other accounts
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元归属者。取值：

Self：查询您创建的共享单元中，共享给其他账号的资源列表。
OtherAccounts：查询其他账号创建的共享单元中，共享给您的资源列表
parameters.name: resource_owner

parameters.help_en:
The type of the shared resource.

For more information about the resource types that can be shared, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html
parameters.help_zh:
共享资源类型。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html
parameters.name: resource_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the principal or resource owner.

If you set `ResourceOwner` to `Self`, this parameter is the ID of a principal.

If you set `ResourceOwner` to `OtherAccounts`, this parameter is the ID of a resource owner
parameters.help_zh:
资源使用者ID或资源所有者ID。取值：

当`ResourceOwner`为`Self`时，该参数为资源使用者ID。
当`ResourceOwner`是`OtherAccounts`时，该参数为资源所有者ID
parameters.name: target

parameters.help_en:
The maximum number of entries to return for a single request.

Valid values: 1 to 100. Default value: 20
parameters.help_zh:
单次请求返回结果的最大条数。

取值范围：1~100。默认值：20
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response is truncated, you can use this token to initiate another request and retrieve the remaining entries
parameters.help_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用`NextToken`再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容
parameters.name: next_token

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the resource share.

The value of N ranges from 1 to 5. You can specify up to 5 resource share IDs
parameters.help_zh:
共享单元ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多指定5个共享单元
parameters.name: resource_share_ids

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the shared resource.

The value of N ranges from 1 to 5. You can specify up to 5 shared resource IDs
parameters.help_zh:
共享资源ID。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多指定5个共享资源
parameters.name: resource_ids

parameters.help_en:
A list of Alibaba Cloud Resource Names (ARNs) of the shared resources.

The value of N ranges from 1 to 5. You can specify up to 5 shared resources
parameters.help_zh:
共享资源ARN列表。

N的取值范围：1~5，即每次最多指定5个共享资源
parameters.name: resource_arns

NextToken.description_en: The pagination token that is used in the next request to retrieve a new page of results. If the response is truncated, you can use this token to initiate another request and retrieve the remaining entries
NextToken.description_zh: 当请求的返回结果被截断时，您可以使用NextToken再次发起请求，获取从当前截断位置之后的内容

SharedResources.description_en: The information about the shared resources

items.description_en: The information about the shared resource

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the resource was associated with the resource share

ResourceArn.description_en: The ARN of the shared resource

ResourceId.description_en: The ID of the shared resource

ResourceShareId.description_en: The ID of the resource share

ResourceStatus.description_en:
The status of the shared resource. This parameter is returned only when you query resources that were shared with you. This parameter is not returned when you query resources that you shared.

Valid values:

Available: The resource is available.

ZonalResourceInaccessible: The resource is unavailable in the current zone.

LimitExceeded: The resource is unavailable because the quota is exceeded.

Unavailable: The resource is unavailable
ResourceStatus.description_zh:
共享资源状态。查询您共享的资源时不返回该参数，查询共享给您的资源时返回该参数。

取值：

Available：资源可用。
ZonalResourceInaccessible：在当前可用区，资源不可用。
LimitExceeded：配额超限，资源不可用。
Unavailable：资源不可用

ResourceStatusMessage.description_en: The reason why the association failed
ResourceStatusMessage.example: The reason for the association failure.

ResourceType.description_en:
The type of the shared resource.

For more information about the resource types that can be shared, see [Services that work with Resource Sharing]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）
ResourceType.description_zh:
共享资源类型。

支持共享的资源类型，请参见[支持资源共享的云服务]（https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/450526.html）

UpdateTime.description_en: The time when the shared resource was updated
